tools.name: get_service_overview
tools.description: Describes Future Home Walk, a paid online service run from Poland, in English, priced in US dollars and available worldwide, that turns the plans of a building into a 3D walkthrough in the browser: what it does, who it is for, how an order works and what its limits are. tools.name: get_pricing
tools.description: Returns the current Future Home Walk price list, which depends on the floor area and is in US dollars, and what the payment covers. Use when the user asks what it costs (Polish: cena, cennik, ile kosztuje, koszt spaceru 3D, ile kosztuje wizualizacja domu lub mieszkania).

tools.name: list_live_demos
tools.description: Lists the public demo walkthroughs of fictional properties: a house, an apartment and a commercial unit, with links that open in a browser. Use when the user wants to see an example (Polish: demo, przykład, dom pokazowy, mieszkanie pokazowe, lokal pokazowy).

tools.name: get_plan_requirements
tools.description: Returns the file types and size limits for uploading plans, and what to prepare for a house, an apartment or a commercial unit. Use when the user asks which files or documents are needed (Polish: jakie pliki, jakie plany, rzuty, przekroje, elewacje, PDF, JPG, wymagania).

tools.name: estimate_sun_hours
tools.description: Calculates sunrise, sunset, day length, noon sun elevation and direct-sun hours for a window facing north, east, south and west (and optionally a given azimuth) at a location, for the 21st of a month.
